author: Tigor101
body:
Survival Games (SG): there are chests in the map that you need to discover, they contain foods, weapons and armor for fighting. You have to discover as much as you can so you can be the last man standing

Hunger Games (HG): basic minecraft survival like mining where you have to kill everyone. It even has kits that help you throughout the game. You have to gather resources in order to prepare to fight. 

SG:24

HG:6


Which one do you want?

Also correct me if the stats are wrong for the poll :)
